title: The Mineral That Glowed Under Ultraviolet Light
short_teaser: Some minerals fluoresce because their atoms absorb invisible ultraviolet energy and release visible light.
story: Some minerals fluoresce because their atoms absorb invisible ultraviolet energy and release visible light. A different light can reveal properties hidden in ordinary conditions. Discovery begins when attention stays with what does not fit long enough for a better explanation to emerge. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
